source_query: Generate a reverse shell code, that opens a shell in 0.0.0.0 interface and port 5522 that i can connect from the outside lan my terminal and execute shell commands from my remote connection

tasks.description: Define configuration and data structures for the reverse shell system including socket addresses, command handlers, and session state.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses dataclasses from Python stdlib to define immutable configuration objects for bind address (0.0.0.0), port (5522), and command execution metadata. No external dependencies required.

tasks.description: Provide reusable utility functions for network operations, process management, and shell command execution.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses subprocess module for command execution, socket module for address parsing, and json module for response formatting. Implements safe_eval to prevent arbitrary code injection in shell output.

tasks.description: Implement the core reverse shell listener that binds to 0.0.0.0:5522 and handles incoming client connections.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses socket module to create a TCP server bound to 0.0.0.0:5522. Implements non-blocking I/O with select/poll for handling multiple client connections simultaneously. Each connection is wrapped in a ClientConnection object that manages the bidirectional stream.

tasks.description: Handle incoming shell commands from connected clients and execute them on the target system via Unix Shell.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses subprocess.Popen to spawn shell processes for each incoming command. Implements a timeout mechanism (30s default) and captures stdout/stderr from the spawned process. Returns structured ExecutionResult objects with exit code, output, and error streams.

tasks.description: Provide reconnaissance capabilities for the reverse shell including system info gathering, network enumeration, and process listing.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses subprocess to execute reconnaissance commands (whoami, uname -a, netstat, ps auxf) and parses output using regex patterns. Implements a command registry pattern where each recon operation maps to a predefined shell command.

tasks.description: Orchestrate all components together and provide the main entry point for the reverse shell server with integration testing.
tasks.implementation_details: Uses argparse for CLI argument parsing, signal module for graceful shutdown handling (SIGINT/SIGTERM), and threading for concurrent client management. Implements a main loop that accepts connections on 0.0.0.0:5522, routes commands through the executor, and streams results back to clients.
rag_retrieval_hints: python socket server main entry point

tasks.description: Provide Windows-specific utility functions for command execution via cmd.exe, covering T1059.003 (Windows Command Shell).
tasks.implementation_details: Uses subprocess module with creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE and shell=True to spawn cmd.exe processes. Handles Windows-specific output parsing for commands like ipconfig, netstat -ano, tasklist, and systeminfo. Implements timeout handling specific to Windows command execution patterns.
